judged_text: The `update` action (wired to PUT /customize/embedding and called by the client's `saveChanges()` via `embedding.update({})`) performs no persistence at all — it just re-serializes the fetched OpenStruct and renders success. The route and the `saveChanges` controller action are a dead/inert pair: the embedding.hbs template has no save button today, and the next maintainer who wires one up gets a request that reports success while saving nothing, a silent no-op masquerading as a working endpoint.

adjudication.rationale: The diff adds PUT /admin/customize/embedding routed to Admin::EmbeddingController#update, but that action only re-serializes the fetched OpenStruct (@embedding) and does not read params or persist anything (app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb). On the client side, admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6 defines saveChanges() that calls this.get('embedding').update({}), yet the new embedding.hbs template has no save button and all real persistence is handled via embeddable_hosts CRUD (Admin::EmbeddableHostsController). So the finding that this route/action pair is currently inert and would be a silent no-op if later wired up is grounded; however it is not a user-facing broken behavior in the current diff because nothing uses saveChanges/update.
